mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_review_log (appointment_id, visitor_name, visitor_phone, decision, reason, confidence, risk_level, latency_ms, model_name, success, error_message, raw_response, create_time) VALUES (#{appointmentId}, #{visitorName}, #{visitorPhone}, #{decision}, #{reason}, #{confidence}, #{riskLevel}, #{latencyMs}, #{modelName}, #{success}, #{errorMessage}, #{rawResponse}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, appointment_id AS appointmentId, visitor_name AS visitorName, visitor_phone AS visitorPhone, decision, reason, confidence, risk_level AS riskLevel, latency_ms AS latencyMs, model_name AS modelName, success, error_message AS errorMessage, create_time AS createTime FROM ai_review_log ORDER BY create_time DESC
